texts.zh:
从[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上收集活体样本的时候发生了事故。由于计算错误，我们的[GetIndividualNamePlural]上配备的牵引光束强度不足。不仅没有得到样本，我们只能短暂地让它们悬浮在空中，然后立马掉到地面上。

我们试图收集的鸟类样本发现这样的事故特别好玩。这些胆子很大的样本甚至开始追逐我们的[GetIndividualNamePlural]，希望也能被带走，而且完全是出于寻求乐子。
texts.en:
An accident occurred while collecting live samples from planet [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. Due to a miscalculation, our [GetIndividualNamePlural] were equipped with tractor beams of insufficient strength. Instead of acquiring the specimen, we only managed to lift them in the air and drop them to the ground shortly after.

The avian specimens we were trying to collect found the accident highly amusing. The bolder specimens even started chasing after our [GetIndividualNamePlural] in a bid to be lifted up too, just for the thrill.

texts.zh:
从[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上收集活体样本的时候发生了事故。由于计算错误，我们的[GetIndividualNamePlural]上配备的牵引光束强度不足。不仅没有得到样本，我们只能短暂地让它们悬浮在空中，然后立马掉到地面上。

其中一些样本掉到了建筑和树的顶部，当地人困惑不已，各种各样的古怪理论冒了出来。
texts.en:
An accident occurred while collecting live samples from planet [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. Due to a miscalculation, our [GetIndividualNamePlural] were equipped with tractor beams of insufficient strength. Instead of acquiring the specimen, we only managed to lift them in the air and drop them to the ground shortly after.

Some of the specimens ended up on top of buildings and trees, baffling the locals and giving life to all sorts of weird theories.
